Use case: precise-object-edit. One EAST run frame 04 with true alpha.
Input 1 is the exact edit target. Keep its head, face, hair, torso, shoulder, both legs and boots, costume, placement, scale and transparent square canvas fixed. Input 2 defines identity only; input 3 defines approved bright, rounded, polished Daoist Q-style painting.
Change ONLY the near anatomical RIGHT sword wrist and the single sword orientation. The right arm is already correctly connected from the visible silver-blue shoulder through the near sleeve to the right hand in front of the hip: preserve that connection and keep that hand approximately where it is. The far LEFT hand holding the one blue talisman stays behind.
Rotate the same straight ice sword upward, nearly vertical instead of its current 45-degree forward diagonal. Render the blade pointing steeply up, a slight lean to screen right, beside the front edge of the face, its tip around x1100 y350 on the same 1254 square canvas. Allow natural wrist adjustment; preserve sword design and length, one complete hilt, no second sword. This is a relaxed running transition from back arm swing to forward arm swing, not an attack. Do not lift the hand high.
Preserve the back/right support boot planted with heel just lifting and the left leg passing forward off the ground. Do not turn feet outward, widen legs, alter foot position, recenter or translate figure. Do not change head/body ratio or shoulder location. Full canvas, full character and entire sword inside margins. No ground/shadow/guides/labels/effects.
